bugs.summary: To fix a data race on Logger.Formatter, the change takes Logger.mu before calling Formatter.Format instead of only around the Out.Write. Format runs user code: a JSON formatter calls MarshalJSON (or String/Error) on field values. If that code logs through the same logger, the nested write() tries to take Logger.mu again, and because sync.Mutex is not reentrant the goroutine deadlocks, hanging the program.
bugs.trigger: A field value whose MarshalJSON calls logrus.Info, logged with the JSON formatter: logrus.WithField("v", v).Info("x") never returns after this change. The fix (f42291d3, issues #1448 and #1440, 'fixes a deadlock introduced in commit 78f8389') snapshots the formatter under the lock and formats outside it.

related_valid: Holding Logger.mu during Format also serializes all formatting across goroutines, so a slow formatter now blocks every other log call (a throughput cost, not a correctness bug).
